entities.name: CTP synthase
observations: Sequence of 542 aa strongly matches reviewed bacterial CTP synthases (82.0–85.7% identity; 100% query coverage).
Annotated as EC 6.3.4.2; catalyzes ATP-dependent amination of UTP to CTP using L-glutamine or ammonia as nitrogen source.
Glutamine-dependent overall reaction: UTP + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O = CTP + L-glutamate + ADP + phosphate + 2 H(+).
Also annotated with glutaminase reaction: L-glutamine + H2O = L-glutamate + NH4(+). Involved in de novo CTP biosynthesis.

entities.name: UTP amination to CTP
observations: Rhea RHEA:26426: UTP + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O = CTP + L-glutamate + ADP + phosphate + 2 H(+).
Alternative nitrogen-source reaction RHEA:16597: UTP + NH4(+) + ATP = CTP + ADP + phosphate + 2 H(+).

entities.name: De novo CTP biosynthesis
observations: Reviewed homologs place the enzyme in pyrimidine metabolism, de novo CTP biosynthesis from UDP, step 2/2.
